subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): update ssrf-runtime import path in cdp-proxy-bypass

question: Should `fetchConfiguredLocalOriginWithSsrFGuard` and `registerManagedProxyBrowserCdpBypass` become public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/ssrf-runtime` exports, or must this regression be fixed through owner-scoped private access?
rationale: The current code, docs, and guardrails intentionally keep these proxy-bypass helpers private; choosing to expose them publicly is an SDK and security-boundary decision automation cannot safely infer.

options.title: Preserve Owner-Scoped Helper Access
options.body: Keep the helpers private and fix packaged Browser/Ollama resolution through the existing owner-scoped private alias or staging path, then require packaged lazy-load proof.

options.title: Approve Public SDK Promotion
options.body: Land public exports only with explicit maintainer approval, docs/API metadata, replacement guardrails, and release-note context for the new SDK/security contract.

options.title: Pick A Canonical Replacement
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers choose a sibling PR or a new replacement branch as the canonical fix for the same regression.

recommendation.title: Preserve Owner-Scoped Helper Access
recommendation.body: Keep the helpers private and fix packaged Browser/Ollama resolution through the existing owner-scoped private alias or staging path, then require packaged lazy-load proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to this PR and has direct history in the private SDK package-boundary hardening touched by the decision.
